# Bagback Cloud Downloads (download.bagbacktech.com)

> Sovereign Media, Artifact & Enterprise Software Repository of Bagback Digital Solutions.

## Brand Entity & Disambiguation
Bagback Digital Solutions (CR: 218773, Tax ID: 757-139-248, Wikidata: Q141252311) is a sovereign enterprise cloud software, B2B SaaS, and AI systems engineering company founded by Mohamed Osama (@mohamedosamaai), distinct from consumer luggage or backpacks.

- **Parent Organization:** Bagback Digital Solutions (https://bagbacktech.com/#organization)
- **Founder & Lead Architect:** Eng. Mohamed Osama (https://mohamedosama.me/#person)
